LEGALLY BINDING RA 10173 COMPLIANT PHILIPPINE LAW CLICKWRAP CONSENT
IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY. This is a legally binding agreement between you ("Client") and articardd Executive vCard OS ("articardd," "Provider," "we," "us"). By ticking the checkbox and tapping Generate My articardd ID, you confirm you have read, understood, and agree to every provision herein. This constitutes valid clickwrap consent under Philippine contract law. If you do not agree, do not register or use the System.
1
Definitions
"articardd" / "System" — The articardd Executive vCard OS in its entirety: the web-based digital vCard, articardd (including Address Book, Upcoming, and Tag modules), articardd ID authentication system, vCard Generator tool, license management engine, and all associated back-end infrastructure.
"Provider" / "articardd" — The individual or entity operating articardd Executive vCard OS, reachable at phpx.migratex@gmail.com.
"Client" / "Owner" / "You" — Any individual or business entity that registers an articardd ID and accesses the System, whether on a Free Trial, Monthly, or Lifetime plan.
"Visitor" / "Contact" — Any third party who views the Client's digital vCard and voluntarily submits their contact details via the vCard Exchange Form.
"articardd ID" — The unique system-generated identifier (format: ATH-XXXXXXXXX) permanently assigned to a Client upon registration. It serves as the Client's username and cannot be transferred or reassigned.
"PIN" — The 6-digit numeric credential paired with the articardd ID for authentication. The Client is solely responsible for its confidentiality.
"License" — The right to access and use the System under the Annual License (₱4,990 per year).
"OS Data" — All data created or stored by the Client within the System, including contact records, transaction entries, wallet balances, meeting bookings, owner profile information, and view counts.
"Visitor Data" — Personal information submitted by Visitors through the vCard Exchange Form: full name, title/company, email address, and mobile number.
"Personal Information" — As defined under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173): any information that directly or indirectly identifies a natural person.
2
Acceptance & Eligibility
This Agreement is accepted exclusively through the clickwrap mechanism on the registration screen: ticking the Terms of Service checkbox and submitting the registration form. This single action constitutes the Client's full and informed consent. No "first use" or implied acceptance applies — only explicit checkbox consent.

By accepting, the Client represents that they are: (a) at least 18 years of age, (b) legally competent to enter into binding contracts under Philippine law, and (c) registering for legitimate professional or business purposes.

Visitors who submit their information via the vCard Exchange Form are subject to the separate Visitor Privacy Notice displayed on the Exchange Form at the point of submission — not this Client Agreement.
3
articardd ID & Authentication
Upon successful registration, the Client receives a permanent articardd ID (e.g., ATH-000000001) and a system-generated 6-digit PIN. These credentials are displayed once at registration and must be saved immediately by the Client. articardd does not store PIN values in recoverable form.

articardd cannot recover a lost PIN. If the Client loses their PIN, the account is inaccessible. The Client acknowledges this limitation and accepts sole responsibility for credential custody.

The Client may change their PIN at any time via Tag → Change PIN, provided they can authenticate with the current PIN. Each articardd ID is unique, permanent, non-transferable, and tied to one (1) individual Client only.

The Client is solely responsible for all activity occurring under their articardd ID. Any suspected unauthorized access must be reported immediately to phpx.migratex@gmail.com.
4
License Plans, Fees & Payment
🗓 Annual License — ₱4,990 per year
The only plan. 12 months of full System access, renewed manually by the Client. No automatic billing. Includes one (1) physical NFC card with shipping, delivered within 21 days of ordering, plus new card themes and mascots released during the license period. License activates within 1–2 business hours of payment verification. Non-refundable once activated, except as stated in Section 14.
💳 Replacement NFC Card — ₱999
If the Client's physical NFC card is lost or damaged, or the Client wants a new design, a replacement card is ₱999 per card. The first card is already included in the Annual License.
Payment Process: All payments are made via manual bank transfer or e-wallet (GCash, BPI, Security Bank, PS Bank, Maya, GoTyme, Netbank, or CIMB Bank). The Client must submit their transaction reference number via the in-app payment form. License activation is manual and subject to articardd's verification.

All fees are quoted in Philippine Peso (₱) and exclusive of applicable government taxes. articardd reserves the right to adjust pricing with 30 days advance notice. Price changes do not apply to an active Annual License until its renewal date.
5
Scope of System & Features
📇 Digital vCard — Shareable NFC/QR business card with contact exchange form, .vcf download, booking request, and social links.

👥 Address Book — Contact management with tagging, social profiles, and .vcf export.

📅 Upcoming / Calendar — Meeting scheduler with list and calendar view.

🏷 Tag & Profile — Owner profile management, social links, and account settings.

Not Included & Not Guaranteed: articardd is not a licensed financial advisor, accountant, or legal consultant. The Financial Tools are organizational aids only. articardd does not guarantee uptime, data persistence, or error-free operation.
6
License Grant & Restrictions
articardd grants the Client a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-sublicensable, non-transferable, revocable license to access and use the System solely for their own professional purposes during the active License period.

Strictly prohibited: sharing or transferring the articardd ID; reverse-engineering or decompiling the System; copying or cloning articardd's design or codebase; using one License for multiple users; circumventing license verification.

Each License covers one (1) articardd ID for one (1) individual Client.
7
Data Ownership, Storage & Retention
The Client retains full ownership of all OS Data and Visitor Data. articardd does not claim any ownership over Client or Visitor data.
Active LicenseRetained indefinitely

The Client is strongly advised to use the Full Backup and Export CSV features regularly. articardd does not sell, rent, or share Client or Visitor data with any third party.
8
Privacy Policy & RA 10173 Compliance
8.1 Governing Law — All personal data processing is governed by the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173), its IRR, and applicable NPC Circulars.

8.2 Roles — articardd is the Personal Information Processor (PIP) for Client account data. The Client is the Personal Information Controller (PIC) for all Visitor Data collected through the vCard Exchange Form, and assumes full legal responsibility for lawful collection and use of that data.

8.3 Data Collected — From Clients: name, position, company, mobile, email, LinkedIn, articardd ID. From Visitors: name, title/company, email, mobile. articardd does not use cookies, tracking pixels, or third-party analytics SDKs.

8.4 Visitor Consent — Visitors are shown a consent notice before submitting their info and retain rights under RA 10173 (Access, Correction, Erasure, Objection, Portability, and to lodge a complaint with the NPC).

8.5 Data Security — In the event of a data breach, articardd will notify the affected Client within 72 hours of discovery.

8.6 Client Obligations — The Client agrees to collect minimal data, use it only for legitimate networking, never sell or share it, and respond to data subject requests within 15 business days.
9
Acceptable Use Policy
Strictly prohibited and may result in immediate termination without refund: spam, phishing, scamming, or impersonation; collecting Visitor data without consent notice; using Financial Tools for illegal activity or money laundering; injecting malicious code; and any use violating RA 10175, RA 8484, or RA 10173.
10
Intellectual Property
The articardd name, brand, logo, vCard design, OS interface, and source code are the exclusive intellectual property of articardd, protected under RA 8293. The Client retains full ownership of their profile information and OS Data. This Agreement transfers no IP rights to the Client.
11
Financial Tools Disclaimer
articardd is not a licensed financial institution, accounting firm, or financial advisor. The Financial Tools are personal organizational aids only and are not substitutes for professional accounting, tax filing, or financial planning. The Client is solely responsible for the accuracy of their financial data and compliance with BIR requirements.
12
Support & Service Levels
Support is available via phpx.migratex@gmail.com, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST, excluding public holidays. Target first response: 24–48 business hours. Support does not cover PIN recovery, financial advice, or third-party service outages.
13
Disclaimers & Limitation of Liability
The System is provided "as-is" without warranties of any kind. Maximum aggregate liability cap: ₱4,990 — regardless of plan type or amount paid. This does not limit liability for gross negligence, fraud, or anything that cannot be excluded under Philippine law.
14
Termination & Suspension
Serious violationsImmediate, no refund

Non-payment7-day grace to renew
articardd may terminate without cause with 30 days' notice — pro-rated refund of the unused portion of the Annual License in the event of platform-wide discontinuation.
15
Force Majeure
articardd is not liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control — natural disasters, government actions, internet/power outages, third-party platform failures, or pandemics. License periods are not automatically extended for such events.
16–18
Amendments, Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
Amendments — Material changes require 30 days' notice via email. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

Governing Law — This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines; proper venue is the courts of Pasig City, Metro Manila.

Dispute Resolution — Direct negotiation (15 days) → formal written demand (15 days) → mediation (30 days) → litigation in Pasig City courts.

This Agreement is the entire understanding between the parties. If any provision is invalid, the rest remains in effect (Severability).
19
ArtiStar Rewards (Referral Program)
19.1 Reward — A Qualified Referral earns the referrer one (1) ₱1,000 Starbucks e-Gift Card. If that card is unavailable, articardd may substitute a gift card or equivalent of the same value. The reward has no cash value and is not transferable.

19.2 Qualified Referral — The buyer must be a new customer who has never held an articardd license, must buy the Annual License at the regular price, and must state the referrer's code or use the referrer's link before paying. Payment must be verified and the license activated by articardd.

19.3 One-time — One reward per buyer. Renewals do not qualify.

19.4 Hold period — The reward is released 14 days after the buyer's license is activated. If the purchase is refunded, cancelled, or reversed within that period, the referral is void and no reward is due.

19.5 Not allowed — Self-referrals (including the same person, email, mobile number, or business), duplicate or repeated referrals of the same buyer, fake or paid-for accounts, and unsolicited bulk messaging or misleading claims. articardd may void any referral it reasonably believes breaks these rules.

19.6 Eligibility and delivery — The referrer must hold an active license when the reward is released. The e-Gift Card is sent to the email or mobile number on the referrer's card. Rewards may be subject to applicable taxes.

19.7 Changes — articardd may change or end this program at any time. Qualified Referrals already verified before a change will still be honored. articardd's decision on whether a referral qualifies is final.
